Response has noticeable lag / first-order-like time constant on order tens of seconds, not an instant jump.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward a low ambient near 0.05-0.10 rather than holding its value.
There is no large dead zone at low u; small u>0 produces a measurable rise.
Steady-state y is approximately linear in u without strong saturation below the soft limit.
The steady-state input needed to hold y=0.5 is in the mid-range approx 0.3-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (<0.01) so trends and end-slope are interpretable for gain and settling.
